lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、ただいまー」
lines.english: “Big Brother, I'm home.”

lines.japanese: 「おかえりー。みかんたくさんあるぞー」
lines.english: “Welcome back. There are lots of tangerines.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、いまいくー」
lines.english: “Okay. Coming.”

lines.japanese: ぱたぱたと廊下を走る音が近づいてきた。
lines.english: Quick footsteps pattered down the hall toward me.

lines.japanese: 「はー、いろいろあってどれにしようか迷っちゃった」
lines.english: “There were so many kinds, I couldn't decide which one to get.”

lines.japanese: 「だからお兄ちゃんを連れていけば良かったのにぷんぷん」
lines.english: “That's why you should've taken Big Brother. Hmph, hmph.”

lines.japanese: 「だってお兄ちゃん、アルバイトあったでしょ」
lines.english: “But you had work.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなものは、小鳩とのお出かけのためならいくらでも休んでやる」
lines.english: “I would skip that as many times as necessary for a day out with Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「だめだよ。まじめに働くって、ほそ川せんせーと約束したんだから」
lines.english: “You can't. You promised Ms. Hosokawa you'd work seriously.”

lines.japanese: ああ、よくそんな、他人同士の細かい約束まで覚えてるなあ。しかもアレ、もう一ヵ月ぐらい前のことなのに。
lines.english: She had an impressive memory for the details of promises between other people. That one had been almost a month ago.

lines.japanese: あれはそう、フリファのミニコンサートの日だっけか──
lines.english: Yes, on the day of the Frickies mini-concert—

lines.japanese: ──あの日、俺は足利美樹氏と逢った。
lines.english: —that day, I met Yoshiki Ashikaga.

lines.japanese: しかし、当然だが、何らかの劇的な真実が発覚ーみたいな分かりやすい展開にはならなかった。
lines.english: Naturally, it did not lead to some simple, dramatic revelation of the truth.

lines.japanese: いや、ある意味では、そうなったのかな。
lines.english: Then again, perhaps in a sense it did.

lines.japanese: 少なくとも俺の中では、もう真相に辿りついていた。
lines.english: At least within myself, I had already reached the truth.

lines.japanese: 母の愛した足利氏──いや、俺の大好きなヨッくん──は、あの日、俺と正面から目を合わせるなり、突然その瞳に潤んだ光を湛えた。
lines.english: Mr. Ashikaga, the man my mother had loved—no, Yoshi, whom I adored—met my eyes directly that day, and his own eyes suddenly shone with tears.

lines.japanese: そして単なる一ファンだとしか名乗っていない俺を、力強く、しかしとても優しく抱きよせた。
lines.english: Then he pulled me, a person who had introduced himself as nothing more than a fan, into a powerful yet immensely gentle embrace.

lines.japanese: お互いの体温を交換したその瞬間、俺には──そして彼にもだろう──すべて分かったんだ。
lines.english: In that instant, as we felt each other’s warmth, I understood everything—and he probably did too.

lines.japanese: 間違いない。あのひとは母さんの──
lines.english: There was no mistake. He was my mother's—

lines.japanese: そして俺の──
lines.english: And my—

lines.japanese: ま、どうでもいいか。
lines.english: Well, it did not matter.

lines.japanese: 向こうには向こうの家庭があるだろうし、なによりそれ以前に、いまの俺が親と呼びたいのは羽田の家のふたりだ。彼に逢ってすっきりしたせいで、なおのことそう実感できる。
lines.english: He must have had a family of his own. More importantly, the two people I wanted to call my parents now were my aunt and uncle in the Haneda home. The clarity I gained by meeting him only made me feel that more strongly.

lines.japanese: 何かが変わったから、何も変わらなかった。
lines.english: Because something had changed, nothing changed.

lines.japanese: 足利美樹は画面の向こうにいる、永遠のアイドルだ。俺はいままで通り、メディアにあの老けた童顔を見つければヒャッホーイと騒いで踊りくるうだけのこと。
lines.english: Yoshiki Ashikaga was the eternal idol beyond the screen. Just as before, whenever I spotted that aging baby face in the media, I would shout “Yippee!” and dance like a madman.

lines.japanese: ゆっくり話がしたいと言ってプライベートな連絡先を頂戴しはしたけれど、いまのところもう会うつもりはない。
lines.english: I had said I wanted to sit down and talk with him, and he’d given me his private contact information. But for now, I had no intention of seeing him again.

lines.japanese: いまのところはね。先のことまでは分からないけれど。
lines.english: For now. I could not speak for the future.

lines.japanese: 鳳翔の言葉を借りるなら、こうだ。
lines.english: To borrow Kakeru Ohtori's words:

lines.japanese: “俺のことなんか俺が知るかよ間抜け”
lines.english: “How the hell should I know about myself, moron?”

lines.japanese: 春の到来を予感させる陽射しから目を逸らし、小鳩の姿を眺める。
lines.english: I looked away from the sunlight promising the arrival of spring and watched Kobato.

lines.japanese: 彼女は俺の贈った進級祝いのプレゼントがだいぶ気に入ったようで、さっきから操作方法を覚えるのに夢中だった。
lines.english: She seemed quite pleased with the gift I'd given her to celebrate advancing a grade. She had been absorbed in learning to use it for some time.

lines.japanese: 「おーい小鳩、ケータイ博士のお兄ちゃんがいろいろ教えてあげるぞう」
lines.english: “Hey, Kobato! Your big brother, the cell-phone professor, will teach you everything.”

lines.japanese: 「わわっ。み、見ちゃダメだよ」
lines.english: “Wah! D-don't look.”

lines.japanese: 「ななななにっ！　いい子ちゃんで知られた小鳩が、俺に見られちゃ困る内容のメールを打っているだと？　なななななんだ、さあ見せなさい、いま見せなさい」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-wh-what?! Kobato, famed throughout the land as a good girl, is composing a message her brother mustn't see? Wh-wh-what is it? Show me. Show me this instant.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　さてはお兄ちゃんを差しおいて森里君にこっそりメールを！？」
lines.english: “Wait! Are you secretly emailing Morisato behind Big Brother's back?!”

lines.japanese: 「ダ、ダメだってば。もういい、私こっちで練習する」
lines.english: “I-I said no. That's enough. I'll practice over here.”

lines.japanese: 「練習？」
lines.english: “Practice?”

lines.japanese: だがその質問には答えず、小鳩は縁側へ行ってしまった。
lines.english: She did not answer. Kobato went out to the veranda.

lines.japanese: ああ、ちょっと疎外感……いいなあ。俺も小鳩のモバイル勉強会に参加したいなあ。
lines.english: Oh. I felt a little excluded... How nice. I wanted to join Kobato's mobile-phone study group too.

lines.japanese: 「ん、んっと、まずは相手の番号を……あど、あどれす入力？」
lines.english: “Um... First, the other person's number... Enter the add... address?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩はなんだか難しい顔をして、携帯電話の内蔵マニュアルと睨めっこしている。親指ではなく人差し指でボタンを押す様がとても初々しい。
lines.english: Kobato frowned at the phone's built-in manual. The way she pressed each button with her index finger rather than her thumb was delightfully inexperienced.

lines.japanese: ああ、小鳩のこういう表情は、滅多に見られないからレアだなあ。
lines.english: Ah, an expression like that was rare on Kobato.

lines.japanese: いいなあ、かわいいなあ。うちの妹はどんな表情してても地球上の生物で一番かわいいなあ。
lines.english: How lovely. How cute. Whatever face she made, my little sister was the cutest living creature on Earth.

lines.japanese: 仮にそのかわいさを体長に換算すれば、おそらくシロナガスクジラにも勝るだろうなあ。そうだ、今度からシロナガスコバトと呼ぼうかなあ。
lines.english: If her cuteness were converted into body length, she would probably surpass a blue whale. Perhaps I should start calling her Kobato the Blue Whale.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あどれす……あどれす……」
lines.english: “A-address... address...”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、シロナガスさん」
lines.english: “Hey, Blue Whale.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あどれながす……えっ、なに？　あ、い、いまちょっと忙しいから」
lines.english: “Blue... addre-whale...? Huh? What? I-I'm a little busy.”

lines.japanese: ははは、お兄ちゃんの相手をしてくれない小鳩もかわいいなあ。
lines.english: Hahaha. Even Kobato refusing to pay attention to Big Brother was adorable.

lines.japanese: っとと、またしても妹のかわいさにどっぷり嵌るところだった。
lines.english: Whoa. I'd nearly fallen deep into my sister's cuteness again.

lines.japanese: そう、その辺も、俺の変わらなかった一部だ。
lines.english: Yes. That too was one part of me that had not changed.

lines.japanese: 小鳩への想いを確かめようと、ここしばらくいろいろ試してみたけど、やっぱり結論は変わらなかった。
lines.english: For a while, I had tried all manner of things to test my feelings for Kobato. My conclusion had not changed after all.

lines.japanese: ああ愛しいなあ。こうして縁側で佇んでいるところを見ると、偶然通りがかった近所のおじいちゃんがぽっくり逝っちゃわないか心配になるくらいかわいいなあ。
lines.english: Ah, how dear she was. Seeing her on the veranda like this, I worried that some elderly neighbor passing by might die on the spot from her cuteness.

lines.japanese: ああ、数秒前に反省したにも関わらず、どっぷり嵌るところだった。いい加減このクセも直さないとな。
lines.english: Ah. Despite reflecting only seconds ago, I'd almost plunged in again. I really needed to break this habit.

lines.japanese: おどけで誤魔化してばかりいないで、この厄介な関係ともいずれは真面目に向きあわなければ。
lines.english: I could not clown my way around it forever. Someday, I would have to face this troublesome relationship seriously.

lines.japanese: しかし、まだだ。まだそのときじゃない。
lines.english: But not yet. The time had not come.

lines.japanese: やっぱり俺は小鳩が好きだ。俺の方は結論がもう見えたけれど、幼い小鳩はまだだろう。
lines.english: I did love Kobato. My own answer was already clear, but Kobato was still too young to have hers.

lines.japanese: いまはまだ彼女の答えをゆっくりと待とう。
lines.english: For now, I would wait patiently for her answer.

lines.japanese: 「できたっ」
lines.english: “I did it!”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 俺が物思いに耽ってるあいだ、小鳩はずっと携帯電話をいじくっていたらしい。
lines.english: While I was lost in thought, Kobato had apparently been fiddling with her phone the entire time.

lines.japanese: 「なにが出来たって？　もうそっち行ってもいいか？」
lines.english: “What did you do? Can I come over now?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、いいよ」
lines.english: “Yes. It's okay.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は一仕事成しとげた風の清々しい笑顔だった。どれどれ、それじゃあお兄ちゃんが、ためになるモバイル勉強会を……。
lines.english: Kobato wore the refreshing smile of someone who had finished a job. Let's see, then. Big Brother would begin his educational mobile-phone seminar...

lines.japanese: と、その前に、ポケットの中で俺のケータイが震えた。
lines.english: Before I could, the phone in my pocket vibrated.

lines.japanese: なんだよもう……いまから小鳩に、お兄ちゃんへのメールの打ち方とか、お兄ちゃんへの電話のかけ方とか、お兄ちゃんへの愛の囁き方とかを教えてあげようと思ったところなのに。
lines.english: Oh, come on. I had been about to teach Kobato how to email Big Brother, how to call Big Brother, how to whisper her love to Big Brother...

lines.japanese: ぼやきながら確認すると、見たこともないアドレスからメールが届いていた。
lines.english: Still grumbling, I checked the screen. A message had arrived from an address I'd never seen.

lines.japanese: 「えーと、ｐｏｐｏｐｏ＠……なんだこれ、誰からのメール――」
lines.english: “Let's see. Popopo at... What's this? Who sent—”

lines.japanese: あっ。
lines.english: Oh.

lines.japanese: ふと正面を見る。俺の妹がにっこり笑っていた。
lines.english: I looked up. My little sister was smiling at me.

lines.japanese: 意図に気付いて、すぐに新着メールを開く。題名は「やったね！」。
lines.english: The moment I understood, I opened the new message. Its subject was “I did it!”

lines.japanese: 『あしたは二人で買い物にいこうね！』
lines.english: “Let's go shopping together tomorrow!”

lines.japanese: 『大好きなお兄ちゃんへ』
lines.english: “To my beloved Big Brother.”
“H-haha...”

lines.japanese: ぱかもの、なんてことするんだ。こんなもの見たら、ますます視界が狭くなるじゃないか。
lines.english: You dummy. What had you done? Reading something like this would only narrow my world further.

lines.japanese: 「ようし小鳩！　いまから出かけるぞ！」
lines.english: “All right, Kobato! We're going out right now!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、いまから！？」
lines.english: “What? Right now?!”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ。帰ってきたばっかりで悪いけど、子供は風の子、元気な子だ」
lines.english: “That's right. Sorry when you just got home, but children are creatures of the wind, bursting with energy.”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんは、小鳩とデートしたいぞう！」
lines.english: “Big Brother wants to go on a date with Kobato!”

lines.japanese: 「でっ、でーと！？」
lines.english: “A d-date?!”

lines.japanese: 「そそ、そんな大声で言ったら恥ずかしいよ」
lines.english: “D-don't say it so loudly! That's embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: なにを今更。自分で嬉し恥ずかしいメールを送っといて。
lines.english: A little late for that, after sending me an email both joyful and mortifying.

lines.japanese: 「どこ行くどこ行く？　今日はお兄ちゃんが、どんなところでも連れてってあげるぞう！」
lines.english: “Where shall we go? Anywhere you like! Big Brother will take you absolutely anywhere!”

lines.japanese: 「う、うんっ」
lines.english: “O-okay!”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、うんだけじゃ分からないぞ。どこがいいかなあ。アレキサンダーもいいし、パルさんトコでもいいなあ……あっ、それとも、ちょっと遠出でもする？」
lines.english: “Hahaha. ‘Okay’ doesn't tell me where. Alexander would be nice, or we could visit Paru... Oh! Do you want to go a little farther?”
“O-okay...”

lines.japanese: 「そうか！　それじゃあ今から二人で小旅行だ！」
lines.english: “Excellent! Then the two of us are taking a trip right now!”

lines.japanese: 「ええーっ！　そ、それはお父さんとお母さんに怒られるよっ」
lines.english: “What?! M-Mom and Dad will be angry!”

lines.japanese: 文句を言いながらも、俺に手をとられて歩きだす小鳩。
lines.english: Even as she complained, Kobato let me take her hand and began walking.

lines.japanese: たまにはいいよな。今日だけは、ちょっと自分を甘やかしてやろう。ふたりきりになって、たくさんイチャついてやる。
lines.english: Once in a while would be fine. Just for today, I would indulge myself. We would be alone together, and I would lavish affection on her.

lines.japanese: あ、でも俺！　シスコンとかロリコンとかそういうの、全っ然ないけどね！
lines.english: Oh, but I have absolutely no sister complex or Lolita complex whatsoever!

lines.japanese: ないけどね！
lines.english: None at all!
